label: Typed Functions (Zith--)
explanation: Zith-- supports statically typed functions with an explicit return type and a final expression as the return value.

label: lend / view Ownership (Zith--)
explanation: Zith-- uses lend and view parameters with explicit call-site annotations for default bindings. This is its own ownership contract, separate from Zith's NRA design.

label: C Interop (Zith--)
explanation: Zith-- can import C declarations from headers and call supported functions directly.

label: C Bind (Zith--)
explanation: Import the supported C/runtime I/O surface with from c/io. The result of puts is discardable, so the call needs no _ =.

label: Pattern Matching (Zith--)
explanation: The when expression matches enum values. Its wildcard arm handles all remaining cases.
